tv: TCL 75T7 / 55Q77K (Smart TV Pro, G08, G08_4K_US, MediaTek tcl9618), US firmware
notes: Same G08 board as the C755/QM6K/85RM7L lists, US build AU16: TCL TV+, messages, e-sticker, dashboard and home pushes, store/hotel/exhibit demo, log capture, Android 14 ad and privacy services, manual/repair/hearing/solo apps, TCL account, browser, Channel+, Alexa and AirPlay, US streaming preloads; ttvs, partnercustomizer, Chromecast and the USB player kept; launcherx and setupwraith off for a custom launcher; one day of use, first 35 reboot-checked; 55Q77K second unit: remote button codes, YouTube as a global key to launcherx, the setup wizard's saved Wi-Fi on an Ethernet set, Apps only mode; 55Q77K third unit: a stale wizard-owned Wi-Fi network removed from the shell, every app button mapped with one key helper; fourth unit: Cast frozen by Android 14's freezer with launcherx off, kept awake by a Home app binding CastReceiverService
